purpose: Post-corruption canonical database rebuild/reconciliation checkpoint. Verifies that the recovered forward stores and synchronized consumers agree before further enrichment.

source_of_truth.rule: Canonical forward datasets are authoritative; indexes, verified layers, reverse indexes, projections, and audit artifacts are consumers/evidence only.

recovery_reconciliation.pq1_rule: PQ1 is an intentional zero-typed-reward boundary: its canonical research record documents only Zeni and an Energy Capsule, with no skill, Super Soul, or equipment reward. See docs/data/pq-reward-boundary-audits/pq-1-typed-reward-boundary-2026-09-28.json.

recovery_history.note: Historical recovery baselines are retained as provenance and are not used as current source-of-truth counts.

validation_boundaries: No canonical skill record was reconstructed from a verified/index/projection layer.
No relationship was created merely because a derived index or normalized map omitted or contained an entry.
No reward probability, Ultimate Finish gate, prerequisite, hidden timing, or race restriction was inferred without direct evidence.
Null race_restriction remains an enrichment gap where reviewed evidence does not establish a narrower CaC restriction.
Runtime/CI/build remains non-blocking and unverified under the current project policy.
next_frontier: Continue evidence-backed restriction review only where direct evidence can establish a narrower rule.
Build a version/patch provenance layer from explicit source evidence; do not invent version fields merely to eliminate nulls.
Continue bidirectional PQ↔skill/Super Soul/equipment enrichment after the recovered forward stores remain synchronized.
Keep canonical forward data authoritative and preserve all recovery history.
